result.title: TCSExam: Evaluating Frontier LLMs on the Full Range of TCS Research
result.comment: 52 pages, 15 figures. Project website: https://moonshotai.github.io/TCSExam/ Code: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/TCSExam
result.summary: Can large language models (LLMs) advance theoretical computer science and resolve its long-standing open conjectures? To study progress toward this goal, we introduce TCSExam, a unified framework and benchmark covering the full range of TCS research. It evaluates theorem proving, solver engineering, and constructions alongside direct attempts to resolve open conjectures, capturing both concrete research accomplishments and progress toward long-standing research goals. TCSExam-Full contains 100 expert-reviewed tasks, with submissions checked by the Lean kernel or an executable task checker. TCSExam-Lite selects 20 tasks, five per track, reducing the number of task attempts by 80% at the same per-attempt budget. We evaluate eight agents on Full and nine on Lite. The TCSExam Index combines all four tracks: GPT-6 Astra leads Full (71.9), and Opus 5.5 leads Lite (72.3). Full and Lite rankings are strongly aligned across eight shared agents (Spearman's $ρ=0.93$), supporting Lite as a compact, discriminative benchmark. The evaluations yield improved solver outputs and mathematical constructions, together with independently verified special cases and bounds from open-conjecture attempts. TCSExam provides an extensible framework with task sources, Docker build recipes, and evaluation tools for reproducible use.

AI.brief_summary: TCSExam 构建了覆盖理论计算机科学研究全范围的统一基准：100 项专家审校任务涵盖定理证明、求解器工程、构造与开放猜想尝试，提交由 Lean 内核或可执行检查器核验；并从中抽取 20 项组成 Lite 版本以降低评测成本，用于比较多个前沿 agent。
